_help: Remark templates that come with the app. The shared copy (saved from the app with the templates key) replaces this list for everyone. client/product '*' = any.

templates.remark: The inspection was carried out on [date] in [place]. Packaged in [packages] with [brand] label corresponding to [varieties], exported from [origin]. The main defects found were [defects]. [temperature recorder]

The inspection was carried out on [date] in [place]. Packaged in [packages] with [brand] label corresponding to [variety] variety, exported from [origin]. The main defects found, based on their average incidence, were [defects]. [temperature recorder] [weight summary] The average fruit distribution across the categories is as follows: 1st cat: [1st cat]%, 2nd cat: [2nd cat]%, non standard: [non standard]%, and waste: [waste]%. grade._help: From the Fresh Pride sheet: a box gets the grade of its worst defect, the final grade is the boxes' average. [from %, grade]: the row with the highest 'from' at or below the defect's %.
